description: Defines Bluetooth GATT socket and attribute classes, including serialization, deserialization, and command handling for Bluetooth communication.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth attribute with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth GATT socket communication, including command execution and notification handling.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Command
classes.description: Encapsulates a Bluetooth GATT command with serialization, deserialization, and response handling.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Response
classes.description: Stores and manages responses from GATT operations, including attribute data and error handling.

methods.name: Attribute::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes attribute data from a byte stream.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Security
methods.description: Sets security level for the GATT socket.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Execute
methods.description: Executes a GATT command with a timeout.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Notification
methods.description: Handles incoming notifications (virtual, to be implemented).

methods.name: GATTSocket::Operational
methods.description: Handles operational state changes (virtual, to be implemented).
